entities.name: Bernabé Zapata Miralles
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Bernabé Zapata Miralles is a Spanish professional tennis player. He has been ranked by the ATP as high as world No. 37 in singles, achieved in May 2023. He also has a career-high doubles ranking of world No. 404, attained in August 2023.
